title: North ABC Trek
description: The North ABC Trek offers a scenic, less-crowded alternative to the classic Annapurna Base Camp route. Passing through lush forests, traditional villages, and stunning mountain landscapes, it leads to the base of Annapurna South for a peaceful and rewarding high-altitude adventure.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Tatopani (5-6 hrs drive) and trek to Narchyang Village
itinerary.description: Begin the journey with a scenic drive from Pokhara to Tatopani, followed by a trek through terraced fields and traditional Magar settlements to Narchyang Village. Overnight in a teahouse.

itinerary.title: Trek from Narchyang village to Chhotepa (2370m) (7-8 Hrs walk)
itinerary.description: Ascent through rhododendron forests offering views of Dhaulagiri and Annapurna. Pass through small villages and spend the night in Chhotepa.

itinerary.title: Trek from Chhotepa to Bhusket mela (3546m) (6-7Hrs walk)
itinerary.description: A more challenging day as the trail ascends into alpine meadows with panoramic mountain views. Proper acclimatization is important. Overnight in a basic lodge.

itinerary.title: Trek from Bhusket mela to North Annapurna Base Camp (4068m) (7-8 hours walk)
itinerary.description: Reach the highlight of the trek — North Annapurna Base Camp. Enjoy breathtaking views of Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Machapuchare.

itinerary.title: Excursion around North Annapurna Base Camp (4190m)
itinerary.description: Rest and acclimatization day with optional hikes to nearby viewpoints. Experience stunning sunrise and sunset over the Annapurna massif.

itinerary.title: Trek back to Hum Khola (2890m) from North Annapurna Base Camp
itinerary.description: Descend through diverse landscapes back to Hum Khola. Easier walking and more comfortable altitude. Overnight in a teahouse.

itinerary.title: Trek back to Lower Narchyang from Hum Khola
itinerary.description: Final day of trekking through familiar trails and villages. Celebrate the completion of your trek with local interactions.

itinerary.title: Drive back to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Return to Pokhara with scenic stops along the way. Check into a hotel and optionally enjoy a celebration dinner.

title: Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) Trek
description: The 5–7 Days Annapurna Base Camp Trek is a short yet breathtaking journey into the heart of the Annapurna Sanctuary, offering some of the most spectacular mountain views in Nepal. This trek is perfect for travelers who want to experience the beauty of the Himalayas but have limited time. Starting from Pokhara, the route passes through traditional Gurung and Magar villages, lush forests of rhododendron and bamboo, and stunning landscapes surrounded by peaks like Annapurna I (8,091 m), Machhapuchhre (6,993 m), and Hiunchuli (6,441 m).

itinerary.title: Pokhara – Nayapul – Ghandruk (1,940 m)
itinerary.description: Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul (1.5 hrs), then trek through beautiful villages and terraced fields to reach Ghandruk, a famous Gurung village offering great views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre.

itinerary.title: Ghandruk – Chhomrong (2,170 m)
itinerary.description: The trail ascends through forested paths and crosses suspension bridges before reaching Chhomrong, the gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary.

itinerary.title: Chhomrong – Bamboo – Dovan (2,600 m)
itinerary.description: Descend to Chhomrong Khola and climb up to Bamboo through thick rhododendron and bamboo forests. Continue trekking to Dovan for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Dovan – Deurali – Annapurna Base Camp (4,130 m)
itinerary.description: Follow the trail through Himalaya and Deurali, with stunning views of the valley and snow peaks. Pass Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700 m) before finally reaching Annapurna Base Camp surrounded by giant peaks.

itinerary.title: Annapurna Base Camp – Bamboo (2,300 m)
itinerary.description: Wake up early for a magical sunrise over Annapurna I and Machhapuchhre. After breakfast, trek back down to Bamboo for the night.

itinerary.title: Bamboo – Jhinu Danda (1,780 m)
itinerary.description: Continue descending through the forest to Jhinu Danda, where you can relax in the natural hot springs near the Modi River.

itinerary.title: Jhinu Danda – Nayapul – Pokhara
itinerary.description: Trek down to Nayapul and drive back to Pokhara. Celebrate the completion of your Annapurna Base Camp adventure!

title: Mardi Himal Trek
description: The Mardi Himal Trek is a short, scenic, and peaceful journey through the Annapurna region. Offering stunning close-up views of Mt. Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli, this moderate trek passes through lush rhododendron forests, traditional Gurung villages, and dramatic ridge-line trails. It's a perfect, less-crowded alternative for those seeking a high-reward Himalayan experience in a limited time.

itinerary.title: Pokhara → Kande → Deurali (2,100 m)
itinerary.description: Drive about 1 hour from Pokhara to Kande, then trek uphill through forest and small villages to Deurali. Enjoy great first-day views of Annapurna and Machhapuchhre.

itinerary.title: Deurali → Forest Camp (2,600 m)
itinerary.description: Trek through peaceful, dense forest filled with rhododendrons and birds. It’s a gradual and scenic climb.

itinerary.title: Forest Camp → Low Camp (2,970 m)
itinerary.description: As the forest thins out, the mountains appear more clearly. Stunning views of the Fishtail peak right in front of you.

itinerary.title: Low Camp → High Camp (3,580 m)
itinerary.description: The landscape turns alpine with stunning ridge-line views. High Camp offers incredible sunset and sunrise photography opportunities.

itinerary.title: High Camp → Mardi Himal Base Camp (4,500 m) → Low Camp or Siding Village
itinerary.description: Early morning hike (approx. 2 hours) to Mardi Himal Base Camp for breathtaking panoramic mountain views. Then trek back down.

itinerary.title: Siding → Pokhara
itinerary.description: Trek down through charming Gurung villages and return to Pokhara by jeep or local transport.

title: Ghorepani-Poonhills Trek
description: The Ghorepani-Poonhills Trek is a classic route famous for its sunrise view over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges from the Poonhill viewpoint. Passing through rhododendron forests and charming villages, it offers a perfect blend of natural beauty and cultural experiences.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul and trek to Tikhedhunga
itinerary.description: Begin with a drive to Nayapul and trek to Tikhedhunga through terraced fields and small villages.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani (2850m) (5-6 Hrs walk)
itinerary.description: Ascend steep stone steps through rhododendron forests to reach Ghorepani. Overnight in a teahouse.

itinerary.title: Early morning hike to Poonhill (3210m) and trek to Tadapani
itinerary.description: Watch the sunrise from Poonhill, then trek to Tadapani through beautiful trails and forests. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tadapani to Ghandruk (1940m)
itinerary.description: Descend through Gurung villages to Ghandruk, a culturally rich village with stunning mountain views.

itinerary.title: Trek from Ghandruk to Kimche and drive back to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Final trek to Kimche followed by a drive back to Pokhara. End the trek with a relaxed evening.

title: Khumai Dada
description: The Khumai Dada Trek leads to the summit of Khumai Dada, a vantage point offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. This trek combines cultural immersion with high-altitude adventure, passing through remote villages and diverse landscapes.

itinerary.title: Drive Pokhara to Ghachowk and Trek to Hile Kharka
itinerary.description: Begin with a scenic drive from Pokhara to Ghachowk, a picturesque village surrounded by hills and forests. From there, start your trek to Hile Kharka, ascending through lush trails and traditional settlements. Enjoy views of terraced fields and the surrounding mountains as you reach your overnight stop at Hile Kharka.

itinerary.title: Trek from Hile Kharka to Kumai Danda for approximately 4-5 hours (3245m)
itinerary.description: Trek from Hile Kharka to Kumai Danda, ascending through rhododendron and pine forests. The trail offers stunning views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges along the way. After about 4–5 hours of moderate hiking, reach Kumai Danda at 3,245 meters and enjoy panoramic vistas before settling in for the night.

itinerary.title: Hike to Korchan Danda (3700m) for a sunrise view and Trek back to Ghachowk.
itinerary.description: Wake up early for a day hike to Korchan Danda (3,700m) to witness a spectacular sunrise over the Himalayas, with clear views of Annapurna and Dhaulagiri. After enjoying the morning views, descend back through forested trails and terraced fields to Ghachowk, where you’ll spend the night.

itinerary.title: Optional to go Tatopani Hot Spring or drive directly back to Pokhara
itinerary.description: On the final day, choose to drive directly back to Pokhara for a relaxed return, or take a detour to visit the natural Tatopani Hot Springs. Soak in the warm, therapeutic waters surrounded by scenic river valleys before continuing the journey to Pokhara, concluding your trek on a refreshing note.

title: Kori Trek
description: The Kori Trek explores the remote Kori Valley, a hidden gem in the Annapurna region. With its untouched trails, traditional mountain villages, and spectacular mountain vistas, this trek provides a unique and off-the-beaten-path experience for adventurous travelers.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Sikles (approx. 3 hours). Explore Sikles, a Gurung village known for its traditional houses and warm hospitality.
itinerary.description: Enjoy a scenic drive from Pokhara to Sikles, passing through lush hills and traditional villages. Upon arrival, explore the charming Gurung village of Sikles, known for its stone-built houses, rich culture, and welcoming locals. Take a short walk to experience village life and enjoy the peaceful mountain surroundings.

itinerary.title: Trek from Sikles to Hugu Goth through rhododendron and oak forests, enjoying waterfalls and mountain views.
itinerary.description: Begin your trek from Sikles, ascending through beautiful rhododendron and oak forests. Cross small streams and waterfalls while enjoying views of the surrounding peaks. The trail leads to Hugu Goth, a quiet village offering a glimpse into traditional highland life. Overnight in a local teahouse.

itinerary.title: Trek from Hugu Goth to Kapuche Lake, the lowest glacier lake in the world. Explore the lake and return to Hugu Goth.
itinerary.description: Set out early for Kapuche Lake, trekking through alpine meadows and rocky terrain. Upon reaching the pristine glacial lake, take time to enjoy its serene beauty and stunning reflections of the mountains. After exploring, return to Hugu Goth for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Trek from Hugu Goth to Nohtha.
itinerary.description: Continue your journey with a trek from Hugu Goth to Nohtha. The trail descends through forests and crosses rivers, leading into a quieter, less-traveled region. Arrive in Nohtha, a remote village surrounded by natural beauty, and spend the night experiencing its peaceful atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Trek to Kori Danda (3800m), the highest point of the trek, offering panoramic views of the Annapurna range.
itinerary.description: Embark on a challenging ascent to Kori Danda, the highest point of the trek at 3,800 meters. Along the way, enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Reach the summit and take in the majestic mountain scenery before descending slightly to camp or stay in a basic shelter.

itinerary.title: Explore Kori Danda, enjoying sunrise and sunset views over the mountains
itinerary.description: Spend a full day exploring the Kori Danda area. Witness a stunning sunrise over the Himalayas, with golden light illuminating the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Enjoy leisurely walks around the ridge, capture sunset views, and soak in the tranquility of this high-altitude paradise. Overnight at the same location.

itinerary.title: Trek from Kori Danda back to Sikles.
itinerary.description: Begin the descent from Kori Danda, retracing your steps through alpine meadows, forests, and traditional villages. Enjoy familiar landscapes from a new perspective as you make your way back to Sikles. Celebrate the completion of the trek with the local community and rest in a teahouse.

itinerary.title: Drive from Sikles to Pokhara.
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back from Sikles to Pokhara. Enjoy scenic views along the way, with opportunities to stop for photos and reflect on your journey. Arrive in Pokhara in the evening, concluding your adventure with a relaxing time by Phewa Lake or exploring the lakeside.

title: Everest Base Camp
description: The Everest Base Camp Trek is the ultimate Himalayan adventure, leading to the base of the world’s highest peak, Mount Everest (8,848m). This iconic journey takes you through vibrant Sherpa villages, ancient monasteries, and high-altitude landscapes with breathtaking views of the Khumbu region.

itinerary.title: Fly from Kathmandu to Lukla and trek to Phakding
itinerary.description: Scenic flight to Lukla followed by a short trek to Phakding. Overnight in a teahouse.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.description: Cross suspension bridges and ascend to Namche Bazaar, the gateway to Everest. Overnight in Namche.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization day in Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Rest and acclimatize with a short hike to Everest View Hotel or Syangboche. Explore the town.

itinerary.title: Trek from Namche to Tengboche (3860m)
itinerary.description: Pass through pine forests to Tengboche, home to the famous Tengboche Monastery. Overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Trek from Tengboche to Dingboche (4410m)
itinerary.description: Ascend through alpine terrain to Dingboche. Acclimatize and enjoy views of Lhotse and Amadablam.

itinerary.title: Trek from Dingboche to Lobuche (4910m)
itinerary.description: Cross the Khumbu Glacier to reach Lobuche. Rest and prepare for higher altitudes.

itinerary.title: Trek from Lobuche to Everest Base Camp (5364m)
itinerary.description: Reach the iconic Everest Base Camp with views of the Khumbu Icefall. Overnight in a teahouse.

itinerary.title: Trek back to Gorak Shep and fly back to Lukla
itinerary.description: Return to Gorak Shep and fly back to Lukla. Overnight in Lukla.

itinerary.title: Fly from Lukla to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Return to Kathmandu by flight. Celebrate the completion of your Everest adventure.

title: Cycling
description: Experience the thrill of mountain biking through scenic trails around Pokhara. From smooth dirt paths to challenging downhill routes, this adventure offers a perfect blend of nature, culture, and adrenaline.
excludes: Tips for guide and support staff

itinerary.title: Arrival in Pokhara & Bike Setup
itinerary.description: Arrive in Pokhara and meet your guide. Get fitted with your bike and gear. Briefing on safety and route details. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Begin Cycling Adventure – Pokhara to Kande
itinerary.description: Start from Pokhara and ride through terraced fields and local villages to Kande. Enjoy views of Machhapuchhre and Annapurna. Overnight in lodge.

itinerary.title: Downhill Ride to Nayapul
itinerary.description: Thrilling downhill section through forests and rural settlements. Stop at viewpoints and cultural spots. End at Nayapul and transfer back to Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Optional Free Day or Skill Session
itinerary.description: Choose between a relaxing day in Pokhara or an optional skill-building session with your guide. Celebration dinner in the evening.

title: UltraLight Flight
description: Soar above the majestic Himalayas in a two-seater ultralight aircraft. Glide over lakes, ridges, and snow-capped peaks with breathtaking panoramic views — a unique way to experience Nepal’s natural beauty.

itinerary.title: Flight Preparation & Safety Briefing
itinerary.description: Arrive at the airfield early morning. Attend a short safety briefing and get equipped with gear. Weather check and final preparations.

itinerary.title: Ultralight Flight Experience
itinerary.description: Take off and enjoy a serene flight over Phewa Lake and the Annapurna range. Capture stunning photos and unforgettable memories. Return to base after landing.

title: Paragliding
description: Soar like a bird with tandem paragliding in Pokhara — one of the best paragliding destinations in the world. Take off from Sarangkot and glide over lush valleys and shimmering lakes with spectacular Himalayan views.

itinerary.title: Early Morning Flight Preparation
itinerary.description: Wake up early and head to Sarangkot. Briefing about takeoff, landing, and safety procedures. Final weather check before flight.

itinerary.title: Tandem Paragliding Adventure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a thrilling flight from Sarangkot to Lakeside Pokhara. Land smoothly by Phewa Lake and celebrate the experience with a certificate.

title: Kayaking
description: Explore the calm waters of Phewa Lake with a guided kayaking tour. Paddle past small islands, temples, and enjoy peaceful views of the Annapurna range reflected on the lake surface.

itinerary.title: Morning Kayaking on Phewa Lake
itinerary.description: Start early at the lake. Learn paddling basics and safety rules. Explore the lake, visit Tal Barahi Temple, and enjoy scenic views.

itinerary.title: Free Time & Optional Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Relax in Pokhara or opt for a sunset boat cruise. Share stories and photos from your kayaking adventure.

title: Rafting
description: Challenge the rapids of the Seti River with an exciting white-water rafting adventure. Navigate through thrilling Class III–IV rapids surrounded by dramatic gorges and lush scenery.

itinerary.title: Departure to River Start Point
itinerary.description: Early pickup from Pokhara. Drive to the river start point. Gear up and receive safety instructions before launching.

itinerary.title: White Water Rafting – Full Day
itinerary.description: Navigate rapids like 'Witch’s Kitchen' and 'Pinball'. Enjoy calm stretches, cliff jumps, and lunch by the river. Finish at the end point and return to Pokhara.

title: Hot Air Balloon
description: Float above the Himalayas in a hot air balloon and witness a magical sunrise over Annapurna and Machhapuchhre. A peaceful and unforgettable aerial journey over Pokhara Valley.

itinerary.title: Early Morning Balloon Flight
itinerary.description: Wake up before dawn and travel to the launch site. Watch the balloon inflate and ascend into the sky. Soar peacefully over mountains and valleys.

itinerary.title: Celebration Breakfast
itinerary.description: After landing, enjoy a celebratory breakfast with champagne. Receive a flight certificate and transfer back to Pokhara.

title: Zipline
description: Experience high-speed ziplining across deep gorges and lush forests near Pokhara. One of the longest and fastest ziplines in Asia, offering breathtaking views and heart-pounding thrills.

itinerary.title: Zipline Orientation & Gear Up
itinerary.description: Arrive at the zipline station. Get geared up and attend a safety briefing. Walk to the first platform while enjoying scenic views.

itinerary.title: Full Zipline Adventure
itinerary.description: Fly across multiple lines, including the longest stretch over a deep gorge. Celebrate with refreshments after completing the course.

title: Bungee Jump
description: Leap from one of the highest bungee jumping sites in the world overlooking the Kali Gandaki Gorge. Feel the rush of freefall and enjoy unmatched Himalayan views.

itinerary.title: Journey to Jump Site & Briefing
itinerary.description: Travel to the bungee jump location. Receive a detailed safety briefing and prepare for the jump.

itinerary.title: Bungee Jump Experience
itinerary.description: Stand on the edge, take the plunge, and feel the ultimate adrenaline rush. Celebrate with a certificate and return to Pokhara.

title: Bird Watching
description: Embark on a serene bird watching expedition through lush forests and wetlands of Nepal, home to over 800 bird species. Spot rare and exotic birds like the Bengal Florican, Himalayan Monal, and Sarus Crane amidst pristine natural habitats.
includes: Bird species checklist and field guide
excludes: Camera or video equipment (other than personal use)

itinerary.title: Arrival & Orientation Walk
itinerary.description: Arrive at the birding destination (e.g., Chitwan National Park or Phewa Lake). Meet your expert birding guide and enjoy a gentle evening walk to spot common species like kingfishers, egrets, and sunbirds. Attend a brief orientation on local bird habitats and conservation.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Bird Watching Expedition
itinerary.description: Start early with a dawn birding walk to catch peak activity. Explore diverse ecosystems—jungle trails, riverbanks, and marshlands—to spot rare and migratory birds. Enjoy a packed lunch in the field and continue afternoon observations. Return in the evening and review the day’s sightings with your guide.

title: Chitwan National Park (3N 4D)
description: Experience the rich biodiversity of Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This 3-night tour includes elephant safaris, canoe rides, bird watching, and immersive Tharu cultural experiences.
excludes: Hotel accommodation in Kathmandu before tour

itinerary.title: Arrival & Orientation
itinerary.description: Arrive in Sauraha, check into lodge, and attend an orientation session. Evening cultural program. Overnight in lodge.

itinerary.title: Elephant Safari & Bird Watching
itinerary.description: Morning elephant safari into the jungle. Afternoon bird watching and visit to a crocodile breeding center. Overnight in lodge.

itinerary.title: Canoe Ride & Village Tour
itinerary.description: Morning canoe ride on Rapti River, followed by a visit to a local Tharu village. Evening free for relaxation. Overnight in lodge.

itinerary.title: Final Morning Activity & Departure
itinerary.description: Optional early bird walk or jungle hike. Depart to Kathmandu or Pokhara by bus or flight.

title: Bardia National Park (2N 3D)
description: Enjoy a short but immersive jungle adventure in Bardia National Park. Ideal for travelers with limited time, this 2-night trip includes wildlife safaris, river boating, and a glimpse into Tharu culture.
excludes: Hotel accommodation in Kathmandu or Pokhara

itinerary.title: Arrival & Afternoon Safari
itinerary.description: Fly to Nepalgunj and drive to Bardia. Check in and go on an afternoon jeep safari. Overnight in lodge.

itinerary.title: River Cruise & Village Tour
itinerary.description: Morning boat ride on the Karnali River, followed by a visit to a Tharu village. Evening campfire. Overnight in lodge.

itinerary.title: Final Morning Safari & Departure
itinerary.description: Early morning wildlife drive, then return to Nepalgunj for flight back to Kathmandu or Pokhara.

title: Pokhara Tour Package
description: Discover the beauty of Pokhara, the gateway to the Himalayas. This 3-day tour includes visits to lakes, temples, viewpoints, and nearby adventure activities, all wrapped in a scenic and cultural experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Lake Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in Pokhara, check into hotel. Afternoon boat ride on Fewa Lake and visit to Tal Barahi Temple. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Sarangkot Sunrise & City Tour
itinerary.description: Early morning drive to Sarangkot for sunrise view. Return for breakfast, then city tour including Devi’s Fall and Gupteshwor Cave. Overnight in Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Free Morning & Departure
itinerary.description: Relax or explore the lakeside. Transfer to airport or bus station for departure.

title: Motorcycle Tour to Lower Mustang (2 Nights / 3 Days)
description: Embark on an exhilarating motorcycle adventure through the rugged trails of Lower Mustang. This 3-day tour takes you from Pokhara to the sacred village of Muktinath via Tatopani, Lete, Marpha, and Jomsom—offering dramatic landscapes, ancient villages, and Himalayan vistas. Perfect for thrill-seekers and cultural explorers alike.
price: 540 USD per person (Heavy discount available for groups of 3–4)
includes: Professional mechanic support throughout the tour
Fuel costs for the entire route
excludes: Tips for guide and support staff
Any additional expenses due to delays or changes in itinerary

itinerary.title: Pokhara → Tatopani → Lete
itinerary.description: Start early from Pokhara on your dirt bike, riding through scenic hills to Tatopani (famous for its hot springs). Continue north along the Kali Gandaki River to Lete, a traditional Thakali village nestled beneath towering cliffs. Overnight in Lete.

itinerary.title: Lete → Marpha Village → Jomsom
itinerary.description: Ride through arid landscapes and deep gorges to the charming apple-growing village of Marpha, known for its whitewashed houses and apple brandy. Explore the monastery and enjoy local snacks before continuing to Jomsom, the administrative hub of Mustang. Overnight in Jomsom.

itinerary.title: Jomsom → Muktinath → Pokhara
itinerary.description: Early morning ride to the sacred pilgrimage site of Muktinath Temple (3,800m), revered by both Hindus and Buddhists. After exploring the temple complex and enjoying panoramic views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges, return to Jomsom and fly or ride back to Pokhara (flight option subject to availability and extra cost if not included). Tour concludes in Pokhara.
